name: Amplitude MCP
description: Lets agents query Amplitude analytics and read or edit charts, dashboards, experiments, cohorts, and tracking-plan events over a hosted OAuth MCP server.

skills.name: Analytics Queries
skills.description: Runs ad-hoc segmentation, funnel, and retention queries, and analyzes experiment results from natural-language prompts.

skills.name: Content Creation
skills.description: Creates and edits charts, dashboards, notebooks, experiments, cohorts, feature flags, and metrics in Amplitude.

skills.name: Tracking Plan Edits
skills.description: Reads and writes tracking-plan events and properties, with two-step confirmed deletes and restores for cleanups.

skills.name: Project AI Context
skills.description: Returns org and project AI Context text with get_amplitude_context so the client applies your metric definitions.

skills.name: Progressive Tool Discovery
skills.description: Starts with a small tool list and discovers tools by category on demand when ?discovery=progressive is on the URL.
